parts.text: ACTION=A4 Rationale: The ego vehicle is traveling straight at 50 kph while another vehicle ahead and to the right (`turning_vehicle`) performs a cut-in maneuver toward the ego's lane ($y = 0.0$). Given the proximity and motion of the cutting-in vehicle, a moderate deceleration (braking) is necessary to maintain a safe following distance and avoid collision. Thus, action A4 (braking/decelerating) is appropriate.
